title: DNA Extraction from Canine Feces for Campylobacter jejuni Detection
author: Sara D. Lawhon
materials: MagMaxTM CORE Nucleic Acid Purification Kit

Combine reagents except for the DNA template in a 1.5ml or 2ml microcentrifuge tube and mix well.
Extract DNA from the feces using the MagMAX™ CORE Nucleic Acid Purification Kit Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #A32700/A32702 following the manufacturer's protocol (outlined below).

The probe is labeled with FAM with Black Hole Quencher 1 (BHQ1) so detection parameters appropriate for FAM or SYBR should be used.The developing laboratory uses Applied Biosystems™ VetMAX™ Xeno™ Internal Positive Control DNA (ThermoFisher Scientific A29762 or A29764) and the VetMAX™ Xeno™ Internal Positive Control - VIC™ Assay (ThermoFisher Scientific A29765 or A29767) to monitor for PCR inhibition. Threshold is set at 0.2.

steps.title: Store fecal samples refrigerated
steps.instruction: Keep fecal samples at 4–8 °C in a refrigerator until processing.

steps.title: Process samples within 72 hours
steps.instruction: Begin processing no later than 72 h after the samples arrive at the laboratory.

steps.title: Weigh feces
steps.instruction: Place 8 g of feces into a 50 mL conical tube.

steps.title: Make feces‑PBS slurry
steps.instruction: Add 32 mL 1X PBS (Life Technologies Catalog #10010‑023) to the 8 g feces, mix to form a feces‑PBS slurry.

steps.title: Settle and clarify slurry
steps.instruction: Let the slurry sit 2 min at room temperature, vortex 30 s, then centrifuge at 100 × g, RT, 1 min.

steps.title: Transfer slurry aliquot
steps.instruction: Pipette 1 mL of the feces‑PBS slurry into a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Prepare bead‑Proteinase K mix
steps.instruction: For each sample combine 20 µL MagMAX CORE magnetic beads with 10 µL MagMAX CORE Proteinase K; add 10 % extra volume for 12 reactions, vortex beads thoroughly to resuspend, and store the mix at 4 °C for up to 1 week if not used immediately.

steps.title: Prepare lysis solution
steps.instruction: For each sample mix 450 µL MagMAX CORE Lysis Solution with 4 µL VetMAX Xeno Internal Positive Control DNA; add 10 % extra for 12 reactions, invert ≥10× to mix, and keep at room temperature for up to 24 h if needed.

steps.title: Collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer 200 µL of the supernatant from the centrifuged slurry (step 5) to a fresh 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Add lysis solution and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 454 µL of the lysis solution (step 8) to the tube, invert ≥10×, then vortex vigorously for 3 min (or use Qiagen MoBio vortex adapter, Cat #13000‑V1‑24) until the sample is fully suspended.

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysed sample at 15 000 × g, RT, 2 min and keep the pellet undisturbed.

steps.title: Load Deep‑Well plate with lysate and beads
steps.instruction: Transfer 200 µL of the clarified lysate (supernatant) to Row A of a KingFisher Deep‑Well plate, add 30 µL bead‑Proteinase K mix (step 7), mix by pipetting up/down several times, and incubate 2 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Add binding solution
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL MagMAX CORE Binding Solution to the same well (Row A) and mix gently.

steps.title: Set up KingFisher plate
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL MagMAX CORE Wash Solution 1 to Row B and 500 µL Wash Solution 2 to Row C of the Deep‑Well plate; place a KingFisher Duo 12‑tip comb (ThermoFisher Cat #97003500) in Row H; add 90 µL MagMAX CORE Elution Buffer to the Elution strip.

steps.title: Run KingFisher extraction
steps.instruction: Load the Deep‑Well plate and the Elution strip into the KingFisher Duo Prime instrument, select the heated script “MagMAX_CORE_DUO.bdz”, and run (≈27 min).

steps.title: Collect eluate
steps.instruction: After the run, cap the Elution strip; store eluate at 4 °C or proceed directly to PCR.

steps.title: Prepare PCR master mix
steps.instruction: Calculate reagent volumes for the desired number of reactions (including 18 µL master mix per reaction), and include a positive control (C. jejuni ATCC 33291/33292/33560 DNA), a negative control (E. coli ATCC 25922 DNA), a No‑Template control, and VetMAX Xeno IPC (Thermo Fisher Catalog #A29762/A29764).

steps.title: Aliquot master mix
steps.instruction: Dispense 18 µL of the master mix into each PCR tube or plate well.

steps.title: Add samples and controls
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate volume of each sample eluate and the designated controls to the corresponding wells.

steps.title: Run PCR
steps.instruction: Place the PCR plate/tubes in a thermocycler and run using the published Campylobacter jejuni gyrA assay cycling conditions.

steps.title: Interpret Ct values
steps.instruction: Record Ct values; Ct ≤ 40 indicates a positive result for gyrA, Ct > 40 or undetermined indicates a negative result.

steps.title: Load instrument script beforehand
steps.instruction: Before first use, load the MagMAX CORE KingFisher script “MagMAX_CORE_DUO.bdz” onto the instrument.
